purpose: Determine whether a finite set of economically distinct credit and governance event concepts has a locally accepted, historically point-in-time structured source contract that can lawfully precede a three-session factor definition.

local_source_inventory_method.scope: repository filenames and already published source contracts or terminal records only
local_source_inventory_method.interpretation: Absence of a locally accepted source contract is a source-admission deferral, not evidence that the economic concept has no predictive value.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: issuer_or_convertible_bond_credit_rating_downgrade_recency
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A close-known issuer or linked convertible-bond credit-rating downgrade may mark a discrete deterioration in near-term financing confidence.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: The mechanism is economically distinct, but the repository has no accepted contract proving historical publication timestamps, rating-state fields, revision semantics, issuer-to-equity mapping and two-market coverage. Campaign127's convertible-issuance source failure cannot be repurposed, and no endpoint or field may be invented from memory.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: shareholder_meeting_dissent_vote_ratio
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: An unusually high close-known dissent ratio may reveal shareholder-governance conflict before it is reflected in three-session prices.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: No accepted local source contract supplies stable issuer identity, meeting publication time, proposal-level affirmative/negative/abstention denominators and revision semantics. Announcement-body parsing or proposal identity classification would be a new text-source campaign, not a permissible post-result rescue.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: environmental_administrative_penalty_recency_or_severity
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A newly disclosed environmental penalty may capture operational and regulatory risk with short-horizon repricing potential.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: No accepted local contract establishes exchange-complete historical publication time, issuer mapping and comparable severity primitives. Reclassifying official enforcement records by environmental keywords would reopen the terminal Campaign113 enforcement-source family and require text classification.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: court_insolvency_or_restructuring_acceptance_recency
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A court's close-known acceptance of insolvency or restructuring proceedings may identify a discrete deterioration or resolution state.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: The repository has no accepted structured contract separating application, acceptance, rejection, creditor, subsidiary and issuer states at close-known timestamps. Title or body classification plus current ST status would introduce text and current-state leakage.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: bond_default_or_interest_payment_delay_event
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A close-known missed principal or interest payment linked to the listed issuer may transmit acute credit stress to the equity over the next three sessions.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: No accepted local contract proves event-state transitions, first-publication time, cure/revision semantics, issuer-to-listed-equity mapping or a non-selected full-market denominator. Sparse anecdotes cannot be read to decide whether to rescue the source.

finite_prevalue_source_catalog.name: employee_stock_ownership_plan_disclosure_intensity
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A close-known employee stock-ownership plan disclosure may proxy for internal alignment or financing demand.
finite_prevalue_source_catalog.reason: This is a title-classified corporate-incentive disclosure adjacent to the terminal CNInfo equity-incentive full-source family. Changing keywords from equity incentive to employee ownership after that source failure is a forbidden source-schema migration, not a new admitted primitive.

selection.reason: None of the six concepts has all of a verified historical point-in-time structured source, stable issuer mapping, admissible primitives and terminal-family independence.

future_revisit_rule.requirements: A later campaign must independently freeze exact official source identity, version, fields, publication-time semantics, issuer mapping, two-market coverage, pagination, revision handling, costs and acceptance gates before any source row or response value is observed.
